description: Federal-contract obligation history for a ticker, OR the fiscal-year leaderboard -- for government-revenue-dependence diligence. TWO SHAPES: exactly one of `ticker` or `fiscal_year` is REQUIRED (both is refused). With `ticker`: per-fiscal-year obligations (USD, the ten largest recipients, dropped_unresolved), NEWEST FY FIRST; with fiscal_year only: a leaderboard of the public companies on Oxford Ledge's USAspending crosswalk, largest first -- not of all federal contractors. A fiscal year still in progress is PARTIAL (period_complete false) and year-to-date -- never compare it to a full year. Obligations are federal awards, not company-reported revenue. `limit` default 20, hard cap 100. An unreachable store is REFUSED (DATA_UNAVAILABLE). Source: USAspending.gov (public domain; OL ticker-crosswalked); FREE. Attributing awards to a ticker is an Oxford Ledge curated crosswalk.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year for the top-contractors leaderboard (not with ticker).

ticker.description: Stock ticker for its per-year history (omit for the FY leaderboard; not with fiscal_year).
